newsitem.title: UK: First Leisure says early H2 trading improved.
newsitem.headline: First Leisure says early H2 trading improved.

text.p: Entertainment group First Leisure Corp said on Tuesday trading in the early part of the second half was better than that experienced in the first half.
It said in a statement this upward trend was temporarily disrupted during the latter weeks of June and through July by the Euro 96 football competition and exceptionally hot weather.
"However, since then, there has been a noticeable improvement in leisure consumer confidence," said the company, which operates bingo clubs, bowling alleys, fitness clubs and nightclubs.
First Leisure said trading had met expectations in all divisions with the exception of Bingo, where market conditions remain depressed.
It said the speed of its development programme has increased which would result "in a substantial number of new unit openings in Nightclubs, Health & Fitness, Brannigans Music Bars and Bingo."

First Lesiure said nightclubs & bars sales for the second half were 21 percent above last year in total, and four percent above on a comparable basis. It expects to release results for the year ending October 31 January 16.
